verdict.rationale: LiveKit Cloud is a hosted service, so a published uptime SLA and a public status page are fair things to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions either. The pricing items cover per-deployment metrics, rollback and always-on agents, which are adjacent features and do not count as an SLA or status page.

support.subject: As a founder, the vendor publishes an uptime SLA and a public status page I can check during an incident
